maria: Heads up — after the kernel-v2.4 merge + new quant-profile rollout we see a ~30% drop in prefix/prompt cache hit rate on the rlhf-chat workload. numbers from last hour: hit_rate 93.8% -> 64.1%.
alex: ack. do we have a sample query that regressed?
maria: yes, saved one sample trace (route: /v1/chat/generate). kv key fingerprint looks different post-merge for some long prompts. suspect key normalization or FP rounding from quantized attention kernels.
jin: can you paste the small repro?
maria: sure: ```
REQUEST_ID=cli-98765 route=/v1/chat/generate model=redwood-v3b quant=fp8-lossy
input_len=512 prefix_len=128 tokens_hash=0x7a3bff
cache_key_pre_v2.4=sha1(userId|session|prompt_slice) -> 0x6d2a...
cache_key_post_v2.4=sha1(userId|session|prompt_slice)|floatbits -> 0x9f4c...
```
alex: that `|floatbits` suffix shouldn't be added, right? we didn't change cache key schema in the feature PR.
maria: no, not intentionally. looks like kernel path is including an internal numeric tag in the KV keying code path when `use_fused_attn=true` and `quant_profile=lossy`.
sandeep: interesting — I saw similar when we added the kernel variant tag in logs. maybe the tag leaked into the keying buffer.
elaine: quick check: which teams rolled the quant profile? prod config shows `quant_profile=lossy` enabled via flag `quant-rollout-2026-02` on the cluster. deploy-bot: deploy completed: kernel-v2.4 merged to us-east-1 on 2026-02-27T09:22Z, flag `quant-rollout-2026-02` toggled at 2026-02-27T09:25Z.
jin: hit-rate numbers by pod: pod-a 66%, pod-b 63%, pod-c 63% — consistent. cold starts not the issue (uptime > 48h).
alex: did we change prefix canonicalization? any whitespace/tokenization differences?
maria: tokenization same. I diffed the canonicalization routine and it's unchanged, but the buffer where we build the key has `memcpy` from fused-attn metadata in the new kernel.
sandeep: can we quickly patch to strip kernel tags before hashing? low-risk fix for a hotpath.
elaine: if we patch, we need a canary (20% traffic) and measure hit-rate + p95 latency.
jin: also check batching heuristics — after the kernel swap we see slight increase in micro-batching at 4-8kb windows, that might change seq-length distribution and affect prefix sharing.
maria: good point. profiler shows more frequent kernel variant switch at runtime which forces cache key reconstruction for similar prompts. sample flame: `build_key -> call_variant -> rebuild_key` now appears 2x.
alex: proposed short list: 1) quick patch to sanitize key buffer (strip variant byte) and canary; 2) toggle `use_fused_attn=false` on a small canary set to confirm root cause; 3) tweak batching window to favor larger batch aggregation for 1s window.
sandeep: I'd add prefetch warmup — proactively prime KV with most common prefixes for high-QPS routes during deployment. helps warmup after kernel swaps.
maria: data: top 50 prefixes account for 42% of requests on this route. a targeted prefetch could restore most of the hit-rate quickly.
ejane: (typo) *elaine
elaine: plan: I'll open canary config change to toggle fused attn off for 10% traffic on cluster-7, and coordinate patch PR to sanitize key.
maria: opening issue with traces + reproducer now. I'll include a small script to compute delta between pre/post key bytes.
alex: timeline?
elaine: toggle in 30m, patch PR in 2h, canary run for 1h, then rollback or roll-forward depending on hit-rate.
maria: quick numbers to watch: prefix_hit_rate, p95_latency, gpu_util, batch_size. target: hit_rate > 90% recovery.
sandeep: note — prefetch should be careful with eviction policy; don't blow out LRU for low-frequency prefixes. we'll limit prefetch to top 100 and cap memory by total bytes.
jin: I'll add an instrumented metric for `cache_key_entropy` (hash distribution skew) to catch future key leaks.
elaine: thanks. maria — post the issue link and the deploy-bot logs once you have them.
maria: posted issue: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-3291 with reproducer and traces.
maria: quick local test: patched key sanitizer removed the variant byte and locally restored hit rate from 64% -> 95% in the replay. pushing PR now.
elaine: PR received, will queue for canary. deploy-bot: patch PR #4287 queued to canary on cluster-7 at 2026-02-27T12:10Z.
alex: if the sanitizer fixes it we should add a unit test to assert key invariants across kernel variants.
sandeep: agreed. also add a short fuzz harness for key builder.
maria: will add tests in the PR.
jean: (typo) *jin
alex: thanks all. keep thread updated with canary numbers.
maria: will do — initial canary numbers in ~45m.
